name: labelled_candidates
title: Three named directions, not three paragraphs
summary: Six candidates are generated under named instructions: raise the stakes, slow down, subvert the expectation, and three are selected for quality and mutual difference. The label is the mechanism: three named directions cost a decision; three unlabelled paragraphs cost three readings. Each candidate arrives already checked, with its flags attached.

steps.title: Six sampled, three shown
steps.note: Every candidate carries its axis label, its rationale, and its flags.

delta_summary: adds beat “The Whisper at the Iron”
shown.text: The Whisper at the Iron Trapped against the locked gate, Kael slams his hand into the iron studs and demands a way out, refusing to look at Mara. Instead of a guard, a low resonance vibrates back through the metal, answering his strike with an identical rhythm. Kael has a hidden connection to the city infrastructure that responds to his touch.

delta_summary: adds beat “The Warden's Decree”
shown.text: The Warden's Decree Kael attempts to slip through the side alley of the market, only to find the Warden of Kell blocking the exit with a detachment of guards, enforcing the total lockdown of Ashfall. The Warden of Kell personally oversees the market lockdown, making escape impossible without a confrontation.

delta_summary: adds beat “The Voice in the Ash”
shown.text: The Voice in the Ash Trapped against the sealed iron gates of Ashfall with the Warden's guards closing in, Kael slams his hand into the ash-covered stone and utters the forbidden name. A deep, subterranean hum answers him, and the ground cracks open to swallow the nearest guard. Kael's connection to the underground entity is real and immediately lethal to his pursuers.

flags.message: The register holds steady as a grim action sequence, avoiding any jarring shifts in vocabulary or mood.

establishes: Kael is at Alleyway outside Kell's market.
establishes: Kael wants Escape Kell's market.
establishes: Voice from Shadows is Offers deals.
establishes: Kael is Desperate.
Kael learns this at The Voice in the Alley
shown.rationale: This beat focuses on Kael's immediate predicament and introduces a new interactive element, slowing down the pace as requested and building suspense.
shown.text: The Voice in the Alley Kael, trapped in the alley as the market gate slams shut, hears a voice from the shadows. It offers a deal, its words echoing in the confined space. Kael, desperate, considers his options. Kael is truly cut off and desperate. An unknown entity has agency and is aware of Kael's situation.

flags.message: The sudden introduction of a mysterious voice offering a deal feels slightly generic compared to the gritty logistical reality of the closed gate.

delta_summary: Kael is not alone
New mystery introduced
Warden's control is questioned
adds beat “The voice”
introduces character The Voice
establishes: Kael: He hears a voice answer him from the gate.
establishes: The Voice is at Kell Gate.
establishes: Kael wants Solve the riddle..
establishes: The Voice: Speaks in riddles.
Kael learns this at The voice
shown.rationale: This beat subverts the expectation of the Warden appearing by introducing a new, mysterious entity. It raises the stakes by presenting Kael with a puzzle rather than immediate physical confrontation, deepening the intrigue of Kell's society.
shown.text: The voice As Kael, trapped in the market square, calls out in desperation, a voice echoes from the closed gate, not from the Warden, but from someone unseen, offering a cryptic riddle. There's another power or presence within Kell, possibly as manipulative as the Warden, and Kael has an unexpected potential ally or adversary.

flags.message: The sudden shift to a cryptic riddle introduces a fantasy trope register that feels slightly detached from the grittier survival tone established in the earlier beats of Ashfall.

delta_summary: adds beat “Mara watches”
shown.text: Mara watches From the shadows of the outer market stalls, Mara watches Kael back into the sealed iron gate as the Warden's guards close in. She hears the strange, low resonance vibrate through the cobblestones before Kael himself even realizes something is answering him. Mara is observing Kael's cornered moment from the market shadows and notices the ground vibrating.

flags.message: The register is consistent, but the heavy redundancy in the prose breaks the reading flow.

steps.title: The writer takes 'deepen the interiority'
steps.note: Accepting commits the diff, extracts facts from any new prose, and shows the bible diff. The alternatives are recorded too, and that is what makes this a preference rather than an event.
